name: Infinite Scroll Product For WooCommerce
author: Farid Mia

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce store with the ultimate product loading experience using Infinite Scroll Product For WooCommerce. This powerful plugin introduces features like AJAX Load More, Infinite Scroll, and AJAX Pagination, ensuring a smooth and uninterrupted shopping experience for your customers. Products load dynamically as users scroll or click to load more, eliminating the need for page reloads and keeping customers engaged.

🌍 Translation Ready

This plugin is fully translation-ready and can be easily translated into any language using Loco Translate or WPML.

🔥 Features:

Advanced Pagination Types
– Infinite Scroll
– Load More Button
– Classic AJAX Pagination

Features Overview

Scroll to Top Control
– Enable or disable automatic scrolling to the top after new products are loaded.

Scroll Target Selector
– Define the element to scroll to (e.g., html, body) for a smoother navigation.

Buffer Pixel Option
– Set how early the next batch of products should start loading.

Load Animation
– Choose a fade, slide, or no animation for a clean loading effect.

Load More Button Styling
– Customize button padding, border radius, and background/text/border colors.

Customizable Button Text
– Personalize your Load More and Loading… texts.

Loader Image Upload
– Use the default spinner or upload your own custom loader.

Flexible Pagination Type
– Choose from Infinite Scroll, Load More button, or AJAX Prev/Next navigation.

Product Count Controls
– Set products per page and per row for layout consistency.

Advanced Selector Settings
– Fine-tune content, loop, and navigation selectors for theme compatibility.

Fully Responsive
– Works seamlessly across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

🎯 Why Use Infinite Scroll for WooCommerce?

  • Increase user engagement by reducing clicks and page reloads.
  • Improve shopping flow and keep customers exploring your products.
  • Enhance conversion rates with a smoother browsing experience.
  • SEO friendly — supports default WooCommerce pagination for search engines.

🔥 **If you found this plugin helpful, you may also like our other plugin:**

🔝 Product Size Guide For WooCommerce – Size Chart for WooCommerce

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Infinite Scroll Settings to configure options.
sections.faq:
How do I configure the AJAX Load More feature?

Navigate to Infinite Scrolling Options and enable AJAX Load More. Customize the button text and loader image as needed.

Can I customize the loading animation?

Yes, you can customize the loader image and text from the plugin settings.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The plugin is optimized for mobile devices to provide a superior shopping experience on any device.

Will this plugin affect my SEO?

No, the plugin is designed to be SEO-friendly, ensuring your store remains optimized even with dynamic content loading.
